title: My wife likes Gold Miner, so I cooked up this game for her 😄
author: Then-Comfortable8258
selftext:
Now I’m wondering if I should spend more time adding content. Would you play something like this? What would you like to see added? Honest feedback is welcome!

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lonkerostudio.goldminer

comments.author: Old-Wolverine-4134
comments.body: I would avoid the chatgpt look at all cost. All such games look the same. It uses the same color palette for everything.

replies.author: Then-Comfortable8258
replies.body: Appreciate it, bro. Most of the art is AI-generated with some error artifacts, but I just need quick results to test my game concepts. My wife likes it, and the 10 acts are done. However, as a software engineer, I don't know if I should spend any more time adding contents on this genre
